label: 激光热处理设备
definition: Laipu's source product-table laser thermal processing equipment basket (激光热处理设备), spanning its named LIC/LIEG/USJLA/DALA models plus unnamed IGBT, SiC and BSI-CCD laser-anneal tools; revenue, units, price and margin are disclosed only at this aggregate level, never per model. Table basis is 主营业务收入 (main-business revenue): the basket's reported total differs from company 营业收入 in every period (residual/其他业务收入 of 431.31/309.30/533.16/780.96万元 for 2023/2024/2025/H1 2026), confirming a main-business partition rather than a total-operating-revenue one. Not additive with the sibling 专用激光加工设备 (specialized, non-thermal laser processing: dicing/marking/debonding/deflash) line, which is out of scope for this category.

label: 公司整体
definition: Laipu company-wide consolidated total (营业收入, 研发投入, top-five customer concentration), covering both the 激光热处理设备 and 专用激光加工设备 product lines plus services; not equipment-specific.

label: 升级改造及其他技术服务
definition: Laipu's upgrade/retrofit and other technical-service revenue line within main-business revenue; a disclosed non-equipment service line, not sales of new tools.

label: 12寸DRAM晶圆激光诱导外延生长设备与工艺（研发项目）
definition: Named ongoing R&D project budget for the LIEG platform's DRAM application, distinct from recognized product revenue (which is only disclosed at the aggregate 激光热处理设备 level).

label: 12寸晶圆整片单步激光退火设备研发（研发项目）
definition: Named ongoing R&D project budget for a new whole-wafer single-step laser-anneal tool for logic/memory ICs; still in R&D (在研) as of this filing, not yet a commercialized platform and not in the p98-99 product table.
